text.aria-label: Title text 'Coverage by phase of an injected load-shift: 15 and 30 day events, both metering groups, 24-120 h ahead Dot: mean over Primary-events. Line: 95% interval from resampling events (not Bonferroni-adjusted). Dashed: the 0.90 target. Scored against the NRA, an estimate. Width-matched: band rescaled to R's mean width.'
text.tspan: Coverage by phase of an injected load-shift: 15 and 30 day events, both metering groups, 24-120 h ahead

Dot: mean over Primary-events. Line: 95% interval from resampling events (not Bonferroni-adjusted). Dashed: the 0.90 target. Scored against the NRA, an estimate. Width-matched: band rescaled to R's mean width.
